points.point: Can background music fade out over the last 3 seconds (API, Combine Clips / Apply Basic Edits, musicConfig)?
Fade option for transitions applies to clips, not music

verdict.reason: None of the candidates states whether background music can fade out or how to set a music fade in the API, and the add-music entry only covers uploading or adding audio in the editor and TikTok autoAddMusic, so no entry answers the question.
